tha-ap24:4.4: catutthī phalikāmayā → catutthā phaḷikāmayā (bj) | catutthī → catutthā (sya-all) | catutthā → catutthi (bj: machasaṁ, sī.selu, the)
tha-ap24:5.1: bhūmi lohitaṅgamayā → nemī lohitaṅkamayā (bj) | tathā pañcamiyā → tattha pañcami yā (sya-all) | nemī → pañca mikācehi (bj: machasaṁ, PTS, sī.selu); tattha pañcamikā ceti (bj: the) | Tathā → tattha (cck: syā. ka.) | bhūmi → nemi (cck: sī.)
tha-ap24:6.2: ratanamayā sabbasoṇṇamayo → ratanāmayā sabbasovaṇṇayo (bj) | ratanamayā → ratanāmayā (sya-all)
tha-ap24:9.1: sattahi ratnehi → sattaratanehi (sya-all) | sattaratanehi → sattahi ratnehi (bj: machasaṁ, sī.selu) | ratnehi → sattaratanehi (cck: sī.)
tha-ap24:11.1: assumha → assumhā (sya-all) | assumha → assumhā (cck: sī. syā.); āsimhā (cck: ?)
tha-ap24:13.3: tiyojanasamubbiddhaṁ → tiṁsayojanamubbedhaṁ (bj) | tiṁsayojanamubbedhaṁ → mubbiddhaṁ (bj: aṭṭhakathā, sīmu) | Tiyojanasamubbiddhaṁ → tīṇi yojanamubbiddhaṁ (cck: sī. ka.)
tha-ap24:16.1: thūpe → sabbaṁ maṇimayaṁ thūpaṁ (bj: machasaṁ, the)
tha-ap24:16.2: te ca → tāva (sya-all) | akaru’ttarakañcukaṁ → akaruṁ te ca kañcukaṁ (bj: machasaṁ, sī.selu, the) | kañcukaṁ → sabbamaṇimayaṁ thūpe, akaruttarakañcukaṁ (cck: sī.)
tha-ap24:17.4: uggato → “garuḷā”ti ādayo catasso gāthāyo, sī.selu, PTS potthakesu na vijjanti (bj note)
tha-ap24:18.4: tathā → tadā (sya-all) | garuḷā → nāgā kumbhaṇḍakā (bj: the)
tha-ap24:21.3: manussā devā → manujā devatā (sya-all) | ca → kumbhaṇḍā (sya-all)
tha-ap24:23.3: phalikāhi chādessāma → eḷikāhi chādayissāma (bj); phalikā chādayissāma (sya-all) | eḷikāhi → phalikaṁ (bj: aṭṭhakathā, sīmu)
tha-ap24:25.4: garuḷā kumbhayakkhakā sabbekaṁsu → kumbhaṇḍā guruḷā tathā sabbekaṁsuṁ (bj) | tathā → kumbhaṇḍā guyahkā tathā (bj: PTS); garuḷā kumbhayakkhakā (bj: aṭṭhakathā, sīmu)
tha-ap24:26.1: sabbekaṁsu → sabbe katā (sya-all) | sabbe’kaṁsuṁ → kathā (bj: machasaṁ, PTS)
tha-ap24:27.2: chattamāropayiṁsu → yāva jaṅghā akaṁsu (sya-all) | te → yāva jaṅghā akaṁsu te (bj: PTS, sī.selu); dhajaṁ chattamakaṁsu te (bj: the)
tha-ap24:27.4: tadā → kumbhaṇḍādīnaṁ paṭipāṭiyā visadisatā ekaccesu dissati. PTS, sī.selu, the, potthakesu chayojanubbedhatā na vuttā. garuḷā ca vajjitā (bj note)
tha-ap24:28.4: āloko hoti → ālokā honti (sya-all) | hoti → ālokā honti (bj: machasaṁ) | hoti → ālokā honti (cck: syā. ka.)
tha-ap24:32.3: evaṁ → etaṁ (sya-all) | gacchantā → gacchanti (sya-all) | gacchantā → gacchanti (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap24:33.1: viruddhā → visaddhā (bj) | visaddhā → viruddhā (bj: machasaṁ, the) | Viruddhā → visaddhā (cck: sī.)
tha-ap24:33.3: pāṭiheraṁ daṭṭhukāmā → pāṭihīraṁ daṭṭhaṭukāmā (bj) | pāṭiheraṁ → pāṭihiraṁ (sya-all)
tha-ap24:34.2: bhatako → varako (sya-all) | bhatako → varako (bj: machasaṁ); vadako (bj: PTS, sī.selu) | bhatako → varako (cck: syā. ka.)
tha-ap24:35.1: uḷāro → oḷāro (sya-all) | heso → eso (sya-all) | he’so → neso (bj: machasaṁ, PTS, sī.selu, the)
tha-ap24:35.4: kubbantanappakaṁ → kubbaṁ na tappare (bj: machasaṁ, the); kubbanti tappare (bj: PTS) | tappare → kubbantanappakaṁ (cck: sī.)
tha-ap24:44.2: susaññā → susaṇhā (bj) | susaṇhā → sutthanā (bj: the); susaññā (bj: bahūsu)
tha-ap24:51.4: jhāpayī mama → jhāpayiṁ mamaṁ (sya-all) | jhāpayī → kilesā jhāpitā (bj: the)
tha-ap24:52.3: samantā ussīsanti → sāmantā ussīyanti (bj) | tiyojanāni samantā ussīsanti → tīṇiyojanasamantā ussissanti (sya-all) | sāmantā → tīṇi yojana sāmattā (bj: sī.selu, the)
